transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there! Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous, heavy exercise or lifting heavy objects for a month.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thank you. Next, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I don't have specific information about using eye gel. I'd recommend contacting your care team for guidance on that. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, if you experience significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, that is not normal and may need further assessment. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, just one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass
